force.description: Decode files that have not changed since their last analysis. Without it, their issues are only checked again against the current settings.

track_ids.description: Tracks to analyse; absent or empty: every track never analysed.

name.description: Unique: artist separation counts plays per artist.

default_filler_mode.description: Used when the pool is empty or a reminder expires; absent: the global setting filler.fallback.

status.description: incomplete: a short segment has no filler mode.

default_filler_mode.description: Leave out for the global setting filler.fallback.

replaced_elements.description: Fixed elements removed because a new fixed element overlaps them.

requires_filler_choice.description: Open the blocking filler dialog for short_segments.

short_segments.description: Short segments without a filler mode.

duration_tolerance_ms.description: A chosen track lasts nominal ± tolerance.

filler_mode.description: Filler of the segment this element holds (see ClockSegment.holder_index).

filler_source_id.description: Playlist ID for playlist, artist ID for artist.

fixed_minute.description: Target start minute of a fixed element.

fixed_tolerance_ms.description: A fixed element may start this much before or after its minute.

playlist_ids.description: The track is chosen from the union of their tracks, in ID order.

filler_source_id.description: Playlist ID for playlist, artist ID for artist; absent otherwise.

fixed_minute.description: Required for a fixed element only.

id.description: An existing element of the clock; leave out for a new one. A new fixed element whose window overlaps an existing one replaces it.

playlist_ids.description: One or more playlists of any type.

build_operation_id.description: The clock_build operation that rebuilds the clock's planned hours (clock_build.completed or .failed).

closed_by_index.description: The fixed element that ends the segment; absent for the last segment.

content_ms.description: Sum of the nominal durations of its elements.

element_indexes.description: Indexes into elements, in play order: start, flow, end elements.

end_ms.description: Target end: the minute of the fixed element that closes it, or 3600000.

fixed_start_ms.description: Where the closing fixed element starts, as close to its minute as its tolerance allows.

holder_index.description: The element whose filler_mode fills this segment: its last element, else the fixed element that opens it, else the one that closes it.

overflow_ms.description: How far the last segment runs past the hour; the crossing track is cut and faded out.

shortfall_ms.description: Time left unfilled; a fixed element may start up to its tolerance early, so its segment is short only beyond that.

start_ms.description: Where its content starts: the start of the hour or the end of the fixed element before it.

hours.description: The grid hours in which play rules block every fitting track.

code.description: Unique slug, for example promo. Cannot be changed later.

kind.description: Entity kind, for example playlist, track, clock.

request_id.description: Request ID, for errors raised by an API request.

time.description: UTC time of the log entry.

Event.description: Any event sent over the WebSocket at GET /api/ws.

field.description: Path of the field, for example elements[2].fixed_minute. Query and path parameters are prefixed with query. or path.

FieldErrorCode.description: Stable code of a field error. Never renamed once released.

track_id.description: Fills the hour's first waiting segment; the clock's default filler mode fills the others.

used_at.description: When it was taken for filler; used tracks stay as history.

deadline_at.description: Without an answer by then, the clock's default filler mode applies.

mode.description: none: the clock is incomplete; ask: the holder asks at air time; pool: the pool is empty.

deadline_at.description: Without an answer by then, the clock's default filler mode applies.

valid_from.description: Station local date, from today to the grid horizon (setting rotation.grid_horizon_days).

valid_to.description: Inclusive; leave out for an open end.

build_operation_id.description: The clock_build operation that rebuilds the changed planned hours.

remaining.description: What is left of it; split leaves two slots, the later one new.

type_id.description: Playlist type of every imported track.

dir.description: The inbox folder relative to the media root (setting import.inbox_dir).

items.description: In path order. Hidden files are not listed; files that are not audio are listed and skipped by an import.

more.description: The folder holds more files than listed.

path.description: Relative to the media root, with forward slashes.

connected.description: The backend reaches Liquidsoap's control interface.

available.description: The bridge's UDP port is open; without it no session can start.

harbor_connected.description: The bridge is connected to Liquidsoap's live input.

on_air_since.description: When audio first reached Liquidsoap in this session.

packets.description: Audio packets received in this session.

state.description: connecting: waiting for audio; on_air: audio reaches Liquidsoap; reconnecting: audio arrives but Liquidsoap's live input is not reachable.

answer.description: The backend's WebRTC answer (SDP) with its candidates.

offer.description: The browser's WebRTC offer (SDP) with all its ICE candidates gathered; the backend does not trickle.

takeover.description: End a running session and start this one (for example after the panel was reloaded). Without it, a running session refuses the offer with live_session_active.

on_air_since.description: When audio first reached Liquidsoap in this session.

reason.description: Why the session ended; only with state off.

state.description: connecting: waiting for audio; on_air: audio reaches Liquidsoap; reconnecting: audio arrives but Liquidsoap's live input is not reachable.

current_clock.description: Name of the clock the grid assigns to the current station hour. Null means none or unknown.

on_air.description: Whether the station is live: a live voice session sends audio. Null means unknown; treat it as on air.

open_outage_id.description: ID of the open outage, if any. Null means none or unknown.

total.description: Number of entries in the file that match the filters.

item_id.description: Plan item; absent for an emergency track.

out_ms.description: Planned out point (plan items) or duration (emergency tracks), in ms.

item_id.description: Plan item; absent for an emergency track.

out_ms.description: Planned out point (plan items) or duration (emergency tracks), in ms.

truncated.description: The plan cuts the track at out_ms with a fade-out.

finished_at.description: Set when the operation is no longer running.

operation_id.description: Its outcome arrives as <kind>.completed or <kind>.failed, and through GET /api/operations/{id}.

total.description: Units of work in total; 0 if unknown.

ended_at.description: Absent while the outage is open.

reconciled_at.description: When its missed items were marked.

missed_count.description: Items marked missed; absent when the marking failed (it is retried).

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next (older) page; absent on the last page.

name.description: Absent when the clock was deleted.

actual_duration_ms.description: How long it played; absent for missed items.

outage.description: Missed items: the outage that kept them off the air.

resolved_item_id.description: The plan item that airs a rescheduled item again.

status.description: missed: planned but not aired (shown as "Not aired").

max_per_hour.description: Starts of the same track within one clock hour.

min_interval_minutes.description: Minutes between two starts of the same track.

playlist_ids.description: Playlists the rule is applied to, in ID order; it applies to each of their tracks.

track_ids.description: Tracks the rule is applied to, in ID order.

weekdays.description: Allowed days, 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday; absent means every day. With a window that crosses midnight, the day on which the window starts.

window_from.description: Start of the allowed window, HH:MM.

window_to.description: End of the allowed window, HH:MM; earlier than window_from when the window crosses midnight.

weekdays.description: 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday; leave out for every day.

window_to.description: HH:MM; earlier than window_from for a window that crosses midnight (22:00 to 02:00).

play_rule_ids.description: Play rules applied to every track of the playlist, in ID order.

code.description: Unique slug; never changes after creation.

is_system.description: True for music, jingle, news, and segment: renamable, never deletable.

connected.description: output: the Icecast output is connected.

elapsed_ms.description: end: how long the track played.

event.description: heartbeat: sent every few seconds while Liquidsoap runs (not journaled).

source.description: start and end: a plan item or an emergency track.

since.description: When the link last changed state.

queue.description: The Liquidsoap queue of its hour.

last_callback_at.description: When the last callback from Liquidsoap arrived.

music_gain.description: The gain last set; absent before the first connect.

now_playing.description: Absent between tracks or when nothing is known.

request_id.description: ID of the request in the logs.

title.description: Short English summary of the problem type.

used_by.description: Entities that block a refused request, for example the playlists that use a type.

ProblemCode.description: Stable code of a problem response. Never renamed once released.

name.description: New display name. The code does not change.

fixed_tolerance_ms.description: Start tolerance of a fixed placement; default rotation.default_fixed_tolerance_ms.

target_hour_start_utc.description: Start of a future station hour within the track plan.

pool_track_ids.description: Replaces the unused tracks of the clock's filler pool, in this order. Leave out to keep the pool.

segments.description: A choice for every short segment; segments filled by the same element need the same choice.

name.description: Environment variable that holds the secret.

filler_source_id.description: Playlist ID for playlist, artist ID for artist.

track_ids.description: Replaces the unused tracks, in this order; used ones stay.

playlist_ids.description: Every playlist the rule applies to; playlists not listed lose it.

track_ids.description: Every track the rule applies to; tracks not listed lose it.

rule_ids.description: Every play rule of the target; rules not listed are removed from it.

track_ids.description: Every track of the playlist; tracks not listed are removed from it. The order is not stored.

value.description: New value; its type and limits are those of the setting (GET /api/settings).

affects_air.description: True when a change affects what goes to air; such changes are logged with their UTC time.

apply.description: When a saved value takes effect. reconnect: when the connection it configures is opened again; changing the stream server briefly interrupts the stream.

default.description: Value used until one is saved.

description.description: English description for developers; the panel shows its own help texts.

group.description: Settings page the key belongs to.

is_default.description: True when no value is saved.

key.description: Setting key, for example liquidsoap.fade_out_ms. The part before the first dot is the group.

maximum.description: Largest allowed number, or longest string length.

minimum.description: Smallest allowed number, or shortest string length.

nullable.description: True when null is a valid value.

unit.description: Unit of a number, for example ms, seconds, kbps.

updated_at.description: When the value was saved; absent for a default.

value.description: Current value: the saved value, or the default when is_default is true.

analyzed_at.description: Absent until the file is analysed.

artist.description: Absent for material without an artist (jingles, station IDs).

codec.description: Codec of the audio stream as ffprobe names it (mp3, aac, vorbis, flac, pcm_s16le, ...). Absent until analysed.

duration_ms.description: Absent until entered or read from the file; such a track cannot be planned.

file_path.description: Relative to the media root, with forward slashes.

fixes.description: Transcodes that remove at least one issue: the buttons Fix loudness and Optimize track (POST /api/tracks/transcode).

loudness_lufs.description: Integrated loudness (EBU R128). Absent until analysed, and for a silent file.

play_rule_ids.description: Rules of the track itself, in ID order. The rules of its playlists apply too.

quality_issues.description: Problems found by the last analysis against the broadcast standard (settings import.*). low_bitrate and file_missing cannot be fixed by a transcode.

quality_ok.description: Absent until the file is analysed.

source_bitrate.description: Bits per second of the lossy file this one was transcoded from; it keeps the low_bitrate issue.

file_path.description: Relative to the media root, with forward slashes, for example music/song.mp3. No absolute paths, backslashes, or .. elements.

playlist_ids.description: Every playlist of the track; playlists not listed lose it.

quality_ok.description: Manual override of the quality check.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to read the next page; absent on the last page.

filler_request_id.description: The filler reminder of this build.

seed.description: Seed of the build; the same input and seed give the same plan.

element_id.description: The clock element it was planned for; absent for filler or a removed element.

planned_out_ms.description: Out point from the start of the track; shorter than duration_ms when truncated.

truncated.description: The track crosses its segment end; it fades out and ends there.

from.description: Hours that start at or after this instant.

to.description: ... and before this one; at most 7 days after from. Hours that have started are never rebuilt.

fix.description: loudness: bring the loudness to stream.loudness_target_lufs, keeping the format. optimize: convert to the broadcast standard (settings import.target_*) and fix the loudness.

output.description: replace: the new file replaces the original. copy: the new file is written as <name>.optimal.<ext> next to the original, which stays on disk; the track then plays the copy.

min_interval_hours.description: At most the play log retention (setting retention.play_log_days) in hours: separation is checked against aired history.

info.description: REST API of the Radio Atlantida backend. No authentication: the API is reachable only from localhost or a private network. All times are ISO 8601 UTC. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with stable codes. UI events are sent over the WebSocket at GET /api/ws; their payloads are the schemas Event, ErrorAlertEvent, and Operation*Event.
info.title: Radio Atlantida API

get.description: Artists with their track count, in name order.

parameters.description: Only artists whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).
parameters.name: q

schema.description: Only artists whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

delete.description: Refused while tracks or clocks (as filler) refer to the artist (artist_in_use, with used_by), and for an artist with play history (artist_has_history).

get.description: Clocks with their status and element count, in name order.

post.description: Runs the dry check and saves the clock (§6.0). A refusal names the element field. A short clock is saved incomplete with requires_filler_choice: the panel then opens the filler dialog and calls save-with-filler or save-incomplete.

delete.description: Refused while grid slots assign the clock (clock_in_use, with used_by naming the slots) and for good once it has play history (clock_has_history).

get.description: The clock with its elements and its layout on nominal durations: segments, shortfall, and the element that holds each segment's filler.

put.description: Replaces the clock and runs the dry check, like create. Elements are matched by id; elements left out are removed. A new fixed element whose start window overlaps an existing one replaces it (check.replaced_elements).

get.description: Specific tracks used in order when the clock needs filler in pool mode. Used tracks stay as history.
get.summary: Get the filler pool of a clock

put.description: Replaces the unused tracks of the pool, in the given order; used ones stay.
put.summary: Set the filler pool of a clock

post.description: Closes the filler dialog without a choice: the clock stays incomplete and shows its warning. Reminders for its short hours in the plan horizon are created by the rebuild.
Stores the filler of each short segment on the element that holds it, and the pool if given. Every short segment must have a filler afterwards, so the clock becomes complete.
post.summary: Save the filler choice of a short clock

get.description: Reminders of short hours that wait for the operator, and of empty filler pools (§7), newest hour first.

post.description: The track fills the hour's first waiting segment, the clock's default filler mode the others, and the hour is rebuilt. Refused (track_id: blocked) when the track breaks separation or a play rule at that time; a pool_empty reminder is closed by refilling the pool instead.

get.description: The assigned hours of the station local dates from ... to, with the UTC start of each hour and its clock. Hours without a clock are left out.

parameters.description: First station local date.
parameters.name: from

schema.description: First station local date.

parameters.description: Last station local date, inclusive; at most 62 days after from.
parameters.name: to

schema.description: Last station local date, inclusive; at most 62 days after from.

post.description: Creates one slot per weekday and hour, in one transaction. Slots that overlap the new dates are trimmed, split, or deleted (replaced lists them). valid_from lies between today and the grid horizon, station local.
post.summary: Assign a clock to grid hours

get.description: Slots in weekday, hour, valid_from order. Weekday, hour, and dates are station local.

parameters.description: Only the slots of this clock.
parameters.name: clock_id

schema.description: Only the slots of this clock.

parameters.description: Only slots valid on some date from this one (station local).
parameters.name: from

schema.description: Only slots valid on some date from this one (station local).

parameters.description: Only slots valid on some date up to this one.
parameters.name: to

schema.description: Only slots valid on some date up to this one.

delete.description: The play history of the slot keeps its clock and loses only the slot. Its planned hours are cleared by a clock_build operation.

post.description: Removes every clock from the weekdays and hours for the dates: overlapping slots are trimmed, split, or deleted.

Starts an import operation: every audio file of the inbox is analysed, moved to the library folder (setting import.library_dir), and registered as a track with the given type and playlists. Title and artist come from the file's tags, else from its name. A file already in the library (same checksum) or not readable as audio stays in the inbox. Refused with media_operation_running while another import, analysis, or transcode runs, and with media_tools_unavailable when ffmpeg is missing.

get.description: The files waiting in the inbox folder under the media root (setting import.inbox_dir), at most 1,000.

delete.description: Ends the live voice session, if any; the music returns to its level.

post.description: Starts a live voice session (§8.4): the browser sends its WebRTC offer and gets the answer; its microphone then goes to air over the music, which is lowered while the session lasts (§8.5). One session at a time. The state is sent as live.state events.

get.description: The state of the live voice input and its session.
Daily log files (one per UTC date), newest first.
Entries of one daily log file, newest first, with optional filters.

parameters.description: Minimum level: WARN returns WARN and ERROR entries.
parameters.name: level

schema.description: Minimum level: WARN returns WARN and ERROR entries.

get.description: Items that did not air because of an outage (§7.1), newest planned first. Open items wait for the manager to reschedule or dismiss them.

post.description: The item will not be broadcast again. Its row is then kept for the play log retention period.

Places the item into a later hour, at its start, its end, or a fixed minute, for that hour only; the clock template is not changed (§7.1, §7.2). Checks that need no build are refused per field; the hour is then rebuilt by a reschedule operation, which fails when the track breaks separation or a play rule at its place or does not fit whole.

get.description: Operations in ID order, for a panel that reconnects and catches up on events it missed. Page with after_id.

delete.description: Deletes a custom type. Refused for a system type (system_type_not_deletable) and for a type that playlists or tracks have (playlist_type_in_use, with used_by listing them).

put.description: Changes the display name; system types can be renamed too. The code does not change.

parameters.description: Only playlists of this type.
parameters.name: type_id

schema.description: Only playlists of this type.

delete.description: Its tracks stay in the library. Refused while a clock uses the playlist in an element or as filler (playlist_in_use, with used_by naming the clocks).

get.description: The tracks of a playlist are listed by GET /api/tracks?playlist_id=.

put.description: Renames the playlist or changes its type.
The rules apply to every track of the playlist, each track checked on its own.
put.summary: Set the play rules of a playlist

put.description: Replaces the membership: listed tracks are in the playlist, others are removed from it. A playlist is a pool, so the order is not stored.
put.summary: Set the tracks of a playlist

post.description: Called by Liquidsoap only: a track start or end, or the Icecast output state (§8.3). A started plan item moves to the play log; the first end of an item records its actual duration. Repeated events change nothing.

get.description: Called by Liquidsoap only, when the plan has nothing to play (§8.2, §8.6): a Liquidsoap request for a random track of the emergency playlist (setting playout.emergency_playlist_id), or 204 when there is none.

200.description: The request to play, for example annotate:track_id="5":/media/a.mp3.

204.description: No emergency playlist, or it has no playable track.

put.description: Sets the live music gain in Liquidsoap (§8.5), for example 0 for an interview and 1 afterwards. The value is kept until changed and set again after a reconnect; the setting liquidsoap.music_gain is the value at startup.

get.description: The Liquidsoap control link, the Icecast output, the track on air, the items waiting in Liquidsoap's queues, and the music gain.
The rules are seeded by the database; their values are copied from the reference software and edited here.

put.description: Changes the interval and the notes. The interval is at most the play log retention in hours.

get.description: Every admin setting with its value, default, limits, and apply mode. A setting that was never saved has its code default and is_default true. Secrets are not listed (see GET /api/settings/secrets).
Whether each secret is set in the environment. Values are never returned; a secret is changed in the environment and takes effect after a restart.

put.description: Validates and saves one value. A refused value returns a field error on value. Secrets cannot be set here (setting_not_editable): they live in the environment.

post.description: Registers a file by its path under the media root; the file may arrive later. When it exists, metadata left out is read from it with ffprobe. A path used by another track is a field error (taken).

Starts an analysis operation: reads format, bitrate, sample rate, channels, duration, and loudness of the files and checks them against the broadcast standard (quality_issues). A missing file gets file_missing. Refused with media_operation_running while another import, analysis, or transcode runs, and with media_tools_unavailable when ffmpeg is missing.

Starts a transcode operation (Fix loudness, Optimize track). A track is skipped when the fix removes none of its issues, while it is queued, on air, or planned to start within playout.prepush_minutes + 5 minutes, and when the target path belongs to another track. Refused with media_operation_running while another import, analysis, or transcode runs, and with media_tools_unavailable when ffmpeg is missing.

delete.description: Removes the track from the library (the file is not touched). Refused while a clock filler pool holds it (track_in_use, with used_by), and for a track with play history or in the track plan (track_has_history).

put.description: Replaces the metadata and the playlists of a track. Optional fields left out are cleared, then metadata is read from the file where it exists.

get.description: Streams the file of the track for the preview player in the panel (§6.6). Supports Range requests, so seeking works. The preview plays in the browser only: it never reaches the air or the play log. A missing file is track_file_not_found.

200.description: The audio file, or the requested range of it.

416.description: The requested range is outside the file.

put.description: Rules of the track itself. The rules of its playlists apply too; all of them must pass.
put.summary: Set the play rules of a track

get.description: Upgrades to a WebSocket. The server sends one JSON text message per event (schema Event); the panel sends nothing. A client that falls behind is disconnected and should reconnect and catch up through GET /api/operations.

101.description: Switching Protocols: the connection is a WebSocket. Each message is one Event.

403.description: Cross-origin request from an origin that is not allowed.
